Surf Zone Forecast
National Weather Service Tallahassee FL
513 AM EDT Tue Oct 13 2026

.THE SURF ZONE FORECAST GENERAL OUTLOOK...

Gentle offshore north to northeast breezes through Friday will hold 
the rip current risk down in the low to moderate category. Strong
northeast breezes will develop on Friday night behind a cold front,
increasing surf and rip current risk along southeast-facing Franklin
County beaches on Saturday.
